top_clusters_by_founders.name: Failed or stalled runs fail silently: nobody gets told
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: API change: webhook events for session failed/errored/terminated on deployments, plus a default idle timeout on multiagent sub-threads that raises thread.idle_timeout to the coordinator and fires the same webhook; doc recipe "Get pinged when a scheduled run fails".

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Can't reconstruct what a run did, which agent did it, or what it cost
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: API change: tag every session event with thread_id and agent name, carry a running token/cost total per thread in the event stream, and add a per-thread summary call (last step, wait state, cost) so which agent did what, and at what cost, is one API call, not a trace dig.

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Recurring runs repeat stale work: no per-run 'today' and no memory of earlier runs
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: API change + doc: deployments inject run context (scheduled_for, run_number, last_successful_run_at) into each session; "Designing a recurring agent" guide separating per-run inputs from persistent memory-store state (items already handled).

top_clusters_by_founders.name: No way to score agent quality over time or across changes
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: API change: persist outcome grader verdicts/scores per session (and per multiagent thread), keyed by agent version, with a list/aggregate endpoint (score by version over time).

top_clusters_by_founders.name: No obvious place for API keys, so they end up in the prompt
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: Doc: "Where do API keys go?" vault quickstart (store in vault, reference from MCP connector/tool config), linked from agent creation, with an API warning when a key-shaped string appears in a system prompt or task.

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Runaway run: no spend cap or stopping point
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: API change: per-session budget cap on by default for scheduled deployments, webhook at 80% and at cap; pair with an outcome stop criterion.

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Agent can't reach data inside the company's private network (VPC)
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: Doc + reference skill: "Reach a database inside your VPC" with a self-hosted, outbound-only MCP server exposing a narrow read-only tool; creds in vault.

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Coordinator hands work (or a placeholder) to the wrong sub-agent
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: API change: handoff validation on multiagent sends. Each callable agent declares a role description and an input contract; a coordinator send whose payload is empty, a known placeholder, or fails the target's contract is rejected back to the coordinator with the list of agents and roles, instead of starting a wasted thread.

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Can't tell whether each agent actually finished its job
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: API change: outcome verdicts per multiagent thread: each sub-agent can carry its own outcome criteria, and the session returns a per-thread verdict record (criteria met yes/no, grader rationale, cost) the founder can read without opening the trace. Same persisted record as the no-quality-scoreboard fix.

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Agent loses track of the task mid-run (context rot, botched memory)
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: Skill + guide: a "task ledger" skill that writes the plan and checklist to a memory store at the start of a run and re-reads/updates it before each step and after any context compaction, so the goal survives long sessions; guide "Keeping long-running agents on task".

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Can't get output files out of a finished session
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: Doc: end-to-end "Get files out of a session" example (write to outputs, list session files, download after end) with plain-language file scope.

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Sandbox dependency setup eats the first day
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: API change: environments declare packages installed once at build and cached across sessions, longer install timeout; preinstall pandas/numpy.

top_clusters_by_founders.name: Must have a human approve before the agent acts externally
top_clusters_by_founders.status_raw: carried (no founder evidence in this run)
top_clusters_by_founders.fix: Doc + skill: "Draft, then approve" pattern (no outbound-send tool or confirm-required policy, draft via files API, outcome = draft ready for review).

fields_per_thread.step: run-manifest step number, or null if the thread matches no step (stray)

fields_per_thread.output_tokens: sum over the thread's model calls
fields_per_thread.cache_read_tokens: sum over the thread's model calls

fields_per_thread.wall_clock_s: first to last event in the thread
fields_per_thread.cost_usd: tokens x per-token price for the model used

derived_metrics.cost_per_step_usd: sum of cost_usd over threads mapped to the step
derived_metrics.run_total_cost_usd: sum of cost_usd over all threads in the run
derived_metrics.wasted_thread_cost_usd: sum of cost_usd over threads flagged STRAY plus threads of steps with verdict fail
derived_metrics.cost_per_passing_step_usd: run_total_cost_usd / number of steps with verdict pass
